lesson.title: The right-angle hunt
lesson.subtitle: Find every match
lesson.story: Right angles can point in different directions. Select every card with the same opening as the reference corner.
lesson.objective: Select all right angles, regardless of orientation.

steps.title: Select all right angles
steps.prompt: Which cards show right angles? Choose every match.
hints: There may be more than one match.

steps.prompt: What matters when you compare angles?

choices.label: The opening between the arms matters, even when the angle is turned.
